meta.title: 孩子被欺负只会讲道理？不如在家演戏训练

scenes.context: 讲者指出打回去解决不了明天的问题，核心是教会孩子如何应对。
sentences: 你今天把那个孩子打了，你明天你的孩子在别的地方又被打，你再去吗？
If you beat the bully today, and your kid gets picked on somewhere else tomorrow, will you keep fighting their battles?
打回去：fight back
我们的目的，是教会孩子怎么去应对这些事情，这是核心。
Our real goal is to teach the child how to handle these situations — that's the core.
核心：the core
这个解决根本不是讲道理，是训练。
This isn't solved by lecturing — it's solved by training.
讲道理：lecture
paraphrase: 替他出头解不了明天的事
Winning today's fight doesn't solve tomorrow.
Handling bullying is a skill, not a lecture.
scenes.speak: If you beat the bully today, and your kid gets picked on somewhere else tomorrow, will you keep fighting their battles? Our real goal is to teach the child how to handle these situations — that's the core. This isn't solved by lecturing — it's solved by training.

scenes.context: 讲者给出训练方法：父母扮演欺凌者与受欺凌者，让孩子学会应对，因欺凌会延续到职场。
sentences: 在家里面，父母之间扮演欺凌者和受欺凌者，然后让你的孩子看。
At home, parents role-play the bully and the bullied, and let your child watch.
欺凌者/受欺凌者：bully / the bullied
校园欺凌到了职场还有职场欺凌，你就需要孩子学会这种生存的技能。
School bullying carries into the workplace — kids need that survival skill.
生存技能：a survival skill
现在也的确需要孩子有保护自己的能力，但这种保护不是让孩子打回去。
Kids do need to protect themselves, but that's not the same as telling them to fight back.
保护自己：protect oneself
paraphrase: Self-protection isn't the same as fighting back.
scenes.speak: At home, parents role-play the bully and the bullied, and let your child watch. School bullying carries into the workplace — kids need that survival skill. Kids do need to protect themselves, but that's not the same as telling them to fight back.

scenes.title_cn: 父亲不缺席+自动化反应
scenes.title_en: An involved dad and automatic response
scenes.context: 讲者强调父亲缺席的孩子不会反抗，训练要形成自动化的自我保护反应。
sentences: 如果爸爸在家庭教育中缺席，这样的孩子是不会打回去的。
When dad is absent from parenting, the child won't push back.
家庭教育中缺席：absent from parenting
狗狗之间经常在闹，它不是打架，它是在训练生存技能。
Dogs wrestle all the time — it's not fighting, it's survival training.
生存技能：survival training
训练这种生存技能，不是为了暴力，是为了保护自己。
We train this survival instinct not for violence, but for self-protection.
自我保护：self-protection
paraphrase: Confidence comes from dad being present.
scenes.speak: When dad is absent from parenting, the child won't push back. Dogs wrestle all the time — it's not fighting, it's survival training. We train this survival instinct not for violence, but for self-protection.

practice: Teach the child how to handle it.
Parents role-play the bully and the bullied.
That's a survival skill for life.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：Teach the child to fight back.
✓ 地道说法：Teach the child to stand up for themselves.
打回去不一定用 fight back，stand up for oneself 更贴「应对」本意。
✕ 直译腔：The dad is absent in family education.
✓ 地道说法：Dad is absent from parenting.
✕ 直译腔：Dogs train their survival skills when fighting.
✓ 地道说法：Dogs wrestle — it's survival training, not fighting.
wrestle 才是狗狗打闹的地道词。
✕ 直译腔：There will be an automated response to beat someone back.
✓ 地道说法：It becomes an automatic, defensive reflex.
shifts: 把保护自己当训练目标
父亲在场，孩子才有底气
footer_notes: ASR 校正：「叮咣五合闹」校正为「叮咣五四地闹」、「咚给一些人打回去」校正为「啪地一下打回去」；「扮演欺凌这个受欺凌的」校正为「扮演欺凌者与受欺凌者」。口播重复句已合并。
